title: LUNARIS actual deployed-app demonstration
method: Actual anonymous Chrome recordings of the deployed application. Editorial crops, cuts and close-ups show the Moon, ten-site selector, UTC/duration controls, Sun/Earth surface geometry, real playback, a confirmed terrain-blocked state, de Gerlache versus Shackleton comparison, editable mission requirements, and the original/delayed/recovered decisions. No generated footage, voice, invented calculations or altered application behavior.
ai_assistance: AI-assisted development and caption writing. Deterministic application decisions; no runtime AI.
limits: Illustrative mission requirements. Center visibility is not power, RF link performance, landing safety or reachable trajectory; seven separate cases are not universal robustness.
coverage: 10 terrain-aware study points; 426-day scientific bundle; nine additional geometry-only context locations.
encoding_tools: FFmpeg 9.0.2 libx264; actual duration and stream dimensions verified using ffprobe.
source_consistency: Application, renderer, engine and scientific bundle are identical between recorded releases; 4cd4b84 changes only the previous video/player/captions/provenance and media test expectation.
